صَاقُورٌ [A pickaxe;] a large فَأْس (AA, S, M, K) with one slender head, with which stones are broken; (AA, S, M;) i. q. مِعْوَلٌ; (AA, S, A;) and ↓ صَوْقَرٌ signifies the same; (M, K;) [but] this latter is expl. by IDrd as meaning a thick فَأْس with which stones are broken. (TA.) ―
-b2- And (assumed tropical:) The tongue. (M, K.) ―
-b3- See also what next follows.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
